column1: # mapping_set_description: Property correspondences applied by ddi122_to_cdif.py (source-agnostic DDI Codebook 1.2.2 XML -> CDIF DataDescription; Nesstar/ICPSR survey metadata).
#   Structural transforms the converter performs that are not term-to-term
#   mappings (so they have no TSV row):
#   - ddi122: subject ids are a minted CURIE convention: XPath-style DDI Codebook 1.2.2 element paths; @name / @intrvl denote XML attributes.
#   - Source-agnostic: makes no repository assumptions - dataset id from <IDNo>, access URL from <accsPlac>, and file distributions carry OGC nil:missing rather than a fabricated download URL.
#   - A CDIF catalog record is ADDED (from <docDscr> producer/prodDate/version); dcterms:conformsTo is derived from content by detect_conformance.

column7: contentUrl = OGC nil:missing when no resolvable download URL (no repository assumptions)
